verdicts.reason: A and B look the same. Both have the same flaws. The missing-image placeholder box (the red/white 'missing asset' tile) collides with 'Saturday 21 June'. The RSVP CTA has shrunk to a pill the same size as the Free Entry / All Ages / Tastings chips, so it is buried. The legal fine print is about as large as the time/venue line and fights it for attention. Fragments are scattered across the strip: 'SOLSTICE PRESENTS' sits under the logo, far from the headline; the subtitle sits off to the side under the title; the URL is pushed to the far right. The tiny product can sits jammed beside the logo. The reading order breaks down and there is no clear grid.
